## What this adds

An index entry for an app or a game (not a shell).

- Name and version:
- Source link and the commit the package was built from:
- Package address (and the sha256 and size in the entry):
- Permissions the app asks for, and why:
- Licence:

## Checklist

- [ ] I built the package from the commit above and signed it with my developer key.
- [ ] The entry follows `submissions/entry.example.json`.
- [ ] The permissions in the entry are the permissions in the package.
- [ ] This is not a shell (shells are installed from their author's own repository).
- [ ] No private key, password or personal data is in this change.
